# iru_tag (Resource)

Manages one Iru Tag. Import by UUID. Device associations are not managed by this resource. Deletion permanently removes the Tag.

Refresh and import select the exact UUID from the paginated Tags listing. The API
does not document a Tag detail GET endpoint. A complete listing without that UUID
removes it from state; malformed or interrupted listings retain state and report
an error. This resource does not own device associations.

## Example Usage


```terraform
resource "iru_tag" "example" {
  name = "Managed with Terraform"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tag UUID.

## Import


```shell
terraform import iru_tag.example 11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555
```


Import by exact Tag UUID and match its existing name for a no-change plan.
The implementation follows the [official Tags API](https://api-docs.iru.com/).
Synthetic lifecycle checks do not establish live API compatibility.
